component.name: wallpaper-rs
component.summary: Animated and static wallpapers for KDE Plasma

description.p: Images, looping videos and scenes as wallpapers, with transitions, one wallpaper per screen and automatic pausing. A daemon renders each screen on the GPU and KDE Plasma shows it through a wallpaper plugin. The app organizes the library, playlists, profiles and online sources and edits images and scenes; the system tray icon offers the basics and wprs-ctl manages everything from a terminal.

Flatpak cannot install the Plasma wallpaper plugin and tray icon. After installing or updating, run flatpak run --command=wprs-plasma io.github.wallpaper_rs.WallpaperRs | sh to install them from this package with kpackagetool6.
